get.description:
Return a list of all Images from a Project's Photo Album (Image Category).

See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: image_category_id
parameters.description: Optional. ID of the image category to filter the images by.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: filters[daily_log_segment_id]
parameters.description: Daily Log Segment ID filter

parameters.name: filters[log_date]
parameters.description: Date of Photos added to the Daily Log in the format "YYYY-MM-DD", or a range of dates in the format "YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: filters[private]
parameters.description: If true, returns only item(s) with a `private` status.

parameters.name: filters[starred]
parameters.description: If true, returns only item(s) with a `starred` status. This will be ignored for users without permission to star photos, returning the unfiltered list rather than an error.

parameters.name: filters[location_id]
parameters.description: Location ID. Returns item(s) with the specified Location ID or a range of Location IDs.

parameters.name: filters[include_sublocations]
parameters.description: Use together with `filters[location_id]`

parameters.name: filters[trade_ids]
parameters.description: Array of Trade IDs. Returns item(s) with the specified Trade IDs.

parameters.name: filters[projection]
parameters.description: Return items with the specified projection type.

parameters.name: filters[query]
parameters.description: Return item(s) containing search query

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[uploader_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) uploaded by the specified User IDs

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by. If the field is passed with a - (EX: -created_at) it is sorted in reverse order

parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description:
The data set that should be returned from the serializer.
The normal view includes default fields, plus links, comments_count, trades.
The android view includes default fields, plus trades, comments.
The mobile view include default fields, plus log_date, trades, comments.
The mobile_feed view includes default fields, plus comments.
The prostore_file view includes default fields, plus images.
The ids_only view does not include default fields, response returns strictly an array of image ids.
Default view is normal.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier for the Image. Use as the {id} path segment in GET/PATCH/DELETE /rest/v1.0/images/{id}.

url.description: Time-limited URL to download the full-resolution image file. Null when the image has been permanently deleted.

thumbnail_url.description: Time-limited URL to the large thumbnail. Null when the image has been permanently deleted.

taken_at.description: Timestamp the photo was captured, from EXIF exposure metadata, in ISO 8601 format. Null when the source file has no capture date.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to Location

permanently_deleted.description: True when the image is marked as permanently deleted.

projection.description: Spatial projection of the image. '360' marks a panoramic photo, which clients render in a dedicated 360 viewer; such images are also eligible for tile generation, but only when the file is larger than MINIMUM_SIZE_FOR_TILE_GENERATION (5 MB). 'regular' is a standard flat photo, and 'unknown' means the projection has not been determined.

image_category_private.description: Whether the Image's category is marked private. Mirrors the private flag of the Image's Image Category.

origin_id.description: ID of the source record this Image originated from (for example, a Daily Log entry). Null when the Image was uploaded directly.

daily_log_header_id.description: ID of the Daily Log day this Image is attached to. Null when the Image is not associated with a Daily Log.

description.example: Work performed during the morning shift

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the segment was soft deleted

deleted.description: Indicates if the segment is deleted

gps_lat.description: GPS latitude extracted from the image EXIF metadata, as a decimal-degrees string. Null when the image has no embedded location data.

gps_long.description: GPS longitude extracted from the image EXIF metadata, as a decimal-degrees string. Null when the image has no embedded location data.

x-changelog.summary: Add source_image_id to request body for Images create endpoint
x-changelog.description: Add an optional `source_image_id` to the request body. When provided, a new independent image is created by copying an existing, policy-visible image in the same project (with its own file storage), and `image_name` is not required. `source_image_id` is mutually exclusive with `upload_uuid` and `data`, and takes precedence when more than one is supplied. The `upload_uuid` and multipart `data` upload flows are unchanged.
